description.en: Shoots Pirate Imps past your defenses. Eventually it can explode and rain down imps.
description.zh: 发射出海盗小鬼，越过你的防线。一段时间后爆炸并投掷出一大群小鬼。

chat.en: The Imps joined the Order of the Cannon Fraternity, Kappa Pea, and quickly rose through the ranks due to constant firing of their leadership.
chat.zh: 这些小鬼们加入了“大炮兄弟经验会”“河童豆”。他们总能因为踢飞老大而不断晋升。

text.en: explodes into a shower of imps if not destroyed quickly
text.zh: 未被及时处理则会炸膛迸发出一群小鬼
